scenario: Debating the pros and cons of remote work
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Waxay badan la isticmaalaa qalabka rasmi ah in la hadlo faa’iido.
Qalab soo bandhigaya fiiri goormaaran oo la qaybiyo fikirradii; waxay ku noqon kartaa bilowga ama dhexdeeda.
Qalabkan wuxuu u yahay 'dhibaato'.
Waxay la isticmaalaa in la ogaado arrimaha.
Marka ugu dambeynta jirka waxay tusaale ahaan 'laakiin' ama 'sey'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: One clear benefit of remote work is that it can increase your productivity, don't you think?
dialogue.translation: Faa’iido jacel oo ka soo jeeda shaqo jira kuwo aad u ah inay ku liiscaan shaqadaada, ma aysan tihiin?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true for some people. However, I've noticed several issues with it.
dialogue.translation: Waxay runtii tahay qaar ka mid ah dadka. Sey, waxaan arkay dhibaato badan oo ku xidhna.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What kind of issues? I think most problems are similar to those you'd face in an office.
dialogue.translation: Waa dhibaato ahaan? Waxaan u maleynayaa in dhibaato badan waxay is weyn tahay kuwa aad ka hor jeeddo xogta.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, remote work may require a lot of self-discipline. If you don't manage your time well, you'll likely fall behind.
dialogue.translation: Nagaa, shaqada jira waxay talin kartaa xataa isku-xukun. Haddii aad u fahmin karto waqti, waa laan la'aan inaad ku noqoto.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see your point. But companies should provide proper training and tools to help employees, though.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan arkay nuqulkii. Laakiin shirkadaha waa inay soo bixiyaan waxbarashada iyo qalabka si ay uga caawiso shaqaalaha, hadana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, they should. Therefore, it's not just about the employee's effort; the employer also has a role.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waa inay yihiin. Sidaa darteed, ma aha inay keliya jirto shaqaalaha; shaqaalaha wuxuu u dhaqmaystaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. And I believe the flexibility remote work offers is a huge benefit that many people value.
dialogue.translation: Runtii. Waxaan u maleynayaa in jiraadka shaqada jira waxay u fiican tahay faa’iido badan oo dad badan u fiican yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree, as long as we address the issues we mentioned. Then it can work well for everyone.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan isku yakamayahay, haddana waxaynu u dhaqmaynaynaa dhibaatooyinka aan ku hadashay. Markaasaa u shaqayn kartaa dadka oo dhan.

key_phrases.translation: Faa’iido jacel oo ka soo jeeda
is weyn kuwa aad ka hor jeeddo
Sidaa darteed, ma aha inay keliya jirto

scenario: Discussing a complex ethical dilemma
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Lugu isticmaalo gerund: avoid doing something.
Haddan quduudkaas, wuxuu u dugaa sabab ama munaasaba aan la shaqeynayo.
Wuxuu u dugaa doortii laba ama in ka badan arrimaha.
Waa in la isticmaal karo sida fiil: to concern = qalad u ahaa.
Badanaa la raacdo gerund: consider doing something.
Wuxuu raacayaa magaca ama gerund, aan raacaynin jumbal la soo qaado fiil la conjuga.
Waa la xiriirbadalada xishoodka ama akhlaaq.
Wuxuu u dugaa aan u fiirinayn ama aan u qaadaneyn xisaab.
Badanaa la isticmaalo gerund: involve doing something.
Isku mid ah natiijo, laakiin badanaa la isticmaalo qalabka rasmi ah ama natiijada.
Waa in laaaan karo si caddaan ah (dhiiganka bulshada, shaqaalaha, iyada oo kale).
Marka ugu dambeynta jumbal wuxuu u dugaa 'sey' ama 'hadana'. Ha isku kordhin conjugation 'though'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We need to decide whether to expose the company's mistake, even though it could cause a huge scandal.
dialogue.translation: Waa inaan u go'anno haddii aan u muujinayno khaladka shirkadda, halmaamise ayuu u dhali karo birqab badnaan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a serious ethical concern. But first, let's consider the outcome of each possible choice.
dialogue.translation: Waa qalad xishood badnaan. Laakiin ugu horeeyey, haa fiirsadaa natiijada doorta kasta oo la sameeyo karo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: If we ignore it, we might avoid immediate problems, but the long-term damage to our reputation could be worse.
dialogue.translation: Haddii aannu ogolaannay, waa inaan u ilaali karnaa dhibaatooyinka adag, laakiin niyadda aan u dambeysayn eachalada ayuu u xumantaa inuu u adag yahay.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True. Yet the pressure from the board to keep this quiet is intense. They don't want any legal trouble, despite the risk.
dialogue.translation: Run. Halmaamise dhiiganka oo ka soo jeeda talada si ay u dhaqan qarsoon waa adag. Ma ay doonayaan dhibaatooyin sharciga, halmaamise khatriyada.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand, but our decision should not involve hiding facts that affect public safety. That would be wrong.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ogahay, laakiin go'aanka aanu ku jira inaanu qarsoon qarsoon oo ay leeyihiin eachalada bulshada. Waxaas baa jira.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree. Still, we need to think about the employees who might lose their jobs if we go public. It's a tough dilemma.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan la yaabi. Haddana, waa inaan u fikirno shaqaalaha oo ay ka hilaan shaqada haddii aan u muujinayno bulshada. Waa su'aalo adag.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. But supporting the right cause sometimes means accepting some collateral damage. We can't just please everyone, though.
dialogue.translation: Soo jeeda. Laakiin ku alin sababka saxa, mararka qaarkood wuxuu u dugaa qabool eachalada la dhaliyey. Ma aanu u qanaci karin qof kasta, sey.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's present both sides to the board and let them decide, but we'll make sure our recommendation is clear.
dialogue.translation: Aad runtahay. Haa u muujin talada laba qaybaha, iyana ha u go'an, laakiin waa inaanu hubinno in go'aanka aanu u soo dirno wuxuu u cadhoon yahay.

scenario: Analyzing the impact of social media on society
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Waxaa la isticmaalaa in la soo sheego talo coyn oo leh asil.
Waxaa u taliyaa sidii dadku u nacasho.
Koox oo dad mid ah oo leh miisaan u adeegsanayo.
Macluumaad la soo ururiyey, badan oo ah digital.

Waxay fiican yihiin ama wanaagsan.
Khadka toban laakiin aan badan.
Waxay u adeegsan yihiin jamacada ama u adeegsan yihiin dadka midbeenta.
Waxaa la isticmaalaa dhammaan jirka hadalka si loo soo sheego.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you think social media has a positive effect on our community?
dialogue.translation: Mise waxaad u maleynaysaa in shabakadada social ay u leedahay asil wanaagsan jamacada?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It can, especially when people share useful information, but it also affects our behavior in several ways.
dialogue.translation: Waa la yaabi'in karaa, sida ay u adag yihiin markii dadku la soo bandhigto macluumaad fiican, laakiin waxayna u asoobtaa suxuunna in badanaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And have you seen the data that shows how much time people spend on these platforms?
dialogue.translation: Oo maxaad aragtay data-ga oo muujinayaa qiyaastii wakhtiga dadku ku wareegsan yihiin shabakadaha?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it's obvious that we're more connected than ever, though sometimes that connection feels superficial.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxay qalad tahay inaan ku xidhnaa in ka badan ugu dambeeyey, hadana markii qiyaastii ay xidhkaasu u eg yahay qalad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, do you think the overall effect is likely to be more harmful than helpful?
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, maxaad u maleynaysaa in asilka u dhexeeya ah ay u dhaqan tahay inay noqoto wax ka badan waxa uu u faydo leh?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not sure. It depends on how we use it. For example, it can be a great tool for organizing social movements.
dialogue.translation: Anigu ma oga. Waxay u adeegsan yihiin sidii aan u isticmaalo. Misaalka, wuxuu noqon karo abaalmarino weyn oo loo isticmaalo in la sameeyo abwaanshada jamacada.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But it also spreads misinformation quickly, which can affect public opinion in a negative way.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin waxayna ku furan yihiin macluumaad khalad ah degdeggan, waxaana u asoobay arimaha dadka si aan u fiican.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. So we need to be critical and not just accept everything we see. That's the key, though.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa u tahay. Haddaba waa inaan noqonno nacasho oo aan u qabillin wax kasta oo aan arkno. Waa su’aalka, hadana.

scenario: Presenting a business proposal
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Qoraad qalab weyn oo loo soo bandhigay.

Waxay u adeegsan tahay inay soo bixiso tashriic ama xiriir dhexdhexaad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm here to present our proposal for the new marketing campaign.
dialogue.translation: Subax wanaagsan, dadka oo dhan. Waxaan halkan u ahay inaan u soo gali talaabada aan u hayno qeybta cusub ee dhisashada ganacsi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks. We have a limited budget, so we need to ensure every dollar counts.
dialogue.translation: Mahadsanid. Waxaan hayno xaqiiqo xadgudub, sidaa darteed waa inaanu dhawrsan noqon in lacag kastoo u fiican yahay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Our strategy focuses on digital ads to reach our target audience more effectively.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Qalab weyna waa inoo jeeda ganacsiga diijitaalka ee aan u soo gaaro dadka aan doonayno si fiican oo kalese.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But how can we achieve significant growth with such a small budget?
dialogue.translation: Laakiin sidee baannu u gaari karno waaxsa xadgudub ee lacagta aan hayno?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the budget is small, we can leverage social media, which is popular among our potential clients.
dialogue.translation: Hadana xaqiiqdu waa yar, waxaan u isticmaal kartaa shabakadaha bulshada ee ah wax ku yaal dhexdooda macmiilka aan awood u hayno.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds promising. What about our current campaigns? Should we replace them?
dialogue.translation: Waxay ku dhex taahay wax fiican. Maxay waxa ay noqon doontaa qeybaha aan hada hayno? Miyaannu beddelno?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We'll adjust them, not replace. Therefore, we can maintain brand consistency while testing new ideas.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan beddelnay doonnaa, aan beddelin. Markaasaa, waxaan u dhaqan qarin kartaa xiriirka ee aan u jeedno fikrad cusub.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Alright, I see the potential. Let's discuss this further in our next meeting.
dialogue.translation: Waa inay noqoto, waxaan arkay awooda. Waxaan ka wada hadalnay doonnaa waxa ku yaal shirka ugu dambeeyey.

key_phrases.translation: soo gali talaabada aan u hayno

scenario: Discussing mental health and wellbeing openly

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been feeling a lot of stress lately, but I haven't talked to anyone about it.
dialogue.translation: Waqtiga dambe waxaan isku halleeyey rabashad badan, laakiin ma hadlaynin qof keliya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's important to be open about these things. I found that talking to a friend really helps.
dialogue.translation: Waxay mid leh inaad furta ahayd waxyaalahan. Waxaan helay in hadalka saaxiib waxay u caawiyaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know, but I don't want to burden anyone. I feel I should handle it alone.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ogahay, laakiin ma doonaynin inaan qof ku xumaan. Waxaan isku halleeyaa inaan u dhaqmo isaga oo xilli.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're not alone, though. Asking for support is a sign of strength, not weakness.
dialogue.translation: Ma aad isku halleeyey, hadana. Talo talo waxay u sheegaa caloosha, ma aha naxariis.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true. Do you have any advice on how to reduce this feeling of being overwhelmed?
dialogue.translation: Waxay runtahay. Ma haysid talo xitaa sidee loo la'aan karo isku halleystee aan ku xumaan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, since exercise works well for me, I try to walk every day. It helps improve my mood.
dialogue.translation: Haa, maxaa yeelay riixinta waxay ii fiicnaa, waxaan isku dayaa inaan sii socdo maalmaal. Waxay u caawiyaa inaan liqino niyadii.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've heard that, but I never seem to find the time. Maybe I can go through a simple routine at home.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan maqashay, laakiin ma naga baan helay wakhti. Bal eeg ayaan karo inaan ku soo jeedo xaalad badan oo ah guri.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a good start. Just remember, you don't have to face this alone, and there's always support available.
dialogue.translation: Waxaas u dhexeeyaa bilow bilahi. Xusuuso, ma aad ku hasbin inaad ku dhaqmayso isaga oo xilli, waxaana taysir leh oo dhan.

key_phrases.translation: ku dhaqmo wixii isaga oo xilli

scenario: Talking about urban vs rural living
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isticmaalka ugu dambeynta jirka in la qaybiyo

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: After living in the city for five years, I'm seriously thinking about moving outside the urban area.
dialogue.translation: Waxay u dambay inaan degay magaalada shana ee sanad, waxaan u adag ah fiiraya inaan u baxdo deegaanka shahada.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? I find cities quite convenient — you have access to everything you need within a short walk.
dialogue.translation: Runtii? Waxaan arkay in magaalooyinku waa u xadgudub badan — waxaad heysaa girid wax kasta oo aad u baahan tahay xadhig yar oo socda.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true, but the constant noise and crowded streets drain me. I want a more peaceful environment.
dialogue.translation: Waa run, laakiin biibsiga dhib ah iyo jidadka dad badan waxay i dhex dhigeeyaan. Waxaan rabaa muhiimad u badnaa oo nabadgely.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. However, rural areas often lack basic facilities like hospitals or good schools.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan fahamay. Haddana, deegaanka degganeeeyaha waxay adag badan tahay qalabka asasiga ah oo kale sida isku shubadda ama macallimada wanaagsan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a fair point. But with remote work, I don't depend on the city for my job anymore.
dialogue.translation: Waa nuqul ku filan. Laakiin shaqo jira, mana isku halleeyo magaalada shaqadeyda.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What about social life and career opportunity? You might feel isolated after a while, though.
dialogue.translation: Maxaa haysta nolosha bulshada iyo qansariga shaqo leh? Waxaad uun kaarsan karto muddo yar oo dambay, sey.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've considered that. But the cost of housing in the city is insane — I can't afford a decent place anymore.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u fikiray. Laakiin kharashka guryaha magaalada waa adag — mana u bixiso doono meel wanaagsan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right, it's a real trade-off. Perhaps a small town outside the city could give you the best of both worlds.
dialogue.translation: Waa inaad run tahay, waa uun badhan. Bal eeg magaalo yar oo ka soo baxay magaalada waxay ku siin karta inaad hesho wixii ugu wanaagsan ee laba dhexdeeda.

key_phrases.translation: wixii ugu wanaagsan ee laba dhexdeeda

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you for the offer, but I’d like to negotiate the salary.
dialogue.translation: Mahadsanid soo bandhigga, laakiin waxaan jeclaan la hadlaya soo bandhigga.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We think the amount we proposed is reasonable, though.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Waxaan u maleynayaa in miisaanka aan soo bandhignay waa xadgudub, hadana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand, but I’d like a 10% increase because the position requires more responsibility.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ogahay, laakiin waxaan jeclaan liisamo 10% maxaa yeelay qaybta waa inay u baahan yahay mas'uuliyad badan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we can adjust the salary if you accept a longer contract term.
dialogue.translation: Owgaayn waxaan la qalmi karnaa xujooyinka haddii aad qabto xisaab badan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That could work, but please include a clause about annual reviews in the conditions.
dialogue.translation: Waxay u shaqayn karayaa, laakiin fadlan ku dar qayb xisaabta oo ku saabsan tixraacyo sanadka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We can do that. Also, we’ll add a health benefit package to the offer.
dialogue.translation: Waxaynuu qaban karnaa. Sidaa darteed, waxaan ku darnaa faائد dhaw dhawaca soo bandhigga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. If the benefit package is included, I’ll accept the terms.
dialogue.translation: Wacan. Haddii faائدka ay ku jirto, waxaan qabnaa xaaladdii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perfect. I’ll send the final contract for you to review.
dialogue.translation: Adag. Waxaan ku soo diri doonaa xisaabka ugu dambeeyey inaad tixraacdo.

scenario: Debating environmental policy with a peer

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue with the new policy is that it's too expensive for small businesses.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa dhibaato wixii ugu weyn ee siyaasadda cusub waa inay kharash weyn tahay ganacsiyaasha yar.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But we have to reduce our emissions somehow. The environment is at stake, and we can't just ignore that.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin waa ina la'aano cadaadadeyada naga baan u jeeda. Duhulwada waxay ku xidhan yahay, oo aanu karaa inaan u qalmo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but the cost of switching to renewable sources will hurt the industry in the short term.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan la yaabi la'aan, laakiin kharashka u badali macmiilka la soo dhaweyn doonaa cadaaladda muddada qarsoon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: However, if we delay, the long-term damage will be even worse. We need to act now.
dialogue.translation: Ase, haddii aannu uun la'aan, kharashka u dambeeyey waxay noqon doontaa adag. Waa ina samayn lahaa hada.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true, but are you against any kind of compromise? Maybe we can phase in the changes slowly.
dialogue.translation: Waxay qumman yihiin, laakiin ma adigu ku xidhan tahay qayb qof? Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u badalino la qaybiyo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not against compromise, but the current plan is too weak. Although I understand your concern about jobs, we need stricter targets.
dialogue.translation: Anigu ma ku xidhan qayb qof, laakiin qorsheynta hada waxay adag tahay. In kastoo aan og yahay qaladkaaga oo kudeedisan, waa ina lahaan doonnoo doonooyin adag.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I still think it's a risky move. The economic impact is likely to be severe, especially for rural areas.

scenario: Discussing the gig economy and job insecurity

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm thinking about leaving my full-time job to do freelance work, but I'm not sure if it's secure enough.
dialogue.translation: Waan fikiraayaa inaan ka baxoo shuqulkayga oo dhan si aan u shaqeyn doono shuqulka aan u baahan yahay, laakiin ma adkayn inay dhowrsan yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. The gig economy gives you more flexible hours, but your income can change every month.
dialogue.translation: Waan ogahay. Isku-shilanka gig waxay ku siin doontaa saacado aanad u dhaqan yahay, laakiin lixle ku bilowguna wuxuu u beddelin karaa bilowga kasta.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true. Although the money is sometimes better, I worry about the lack of benefits like health insurance.
dialogue.translation: Runtii bay. Hadana lacagta waxay u fiican yihiin, laakiin waan ku qalqaanayaa faa’iidooyinka aan lahayn sida dhaw ahaan bixinta afyaaniska.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, many companies hire gig workers without any contract, so they don't provide any benefits at all.
dialogue.translation: Haa, shirkad badan ayaa wareejisan yihiin shaqaalaha gig aan qayb qayb weyn leh, sidaas daraaddeed ma ay siin doonaan faa’iido.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And as an independent worker, you have to take on more risk because you don't have an employer to rely on.
dialogue.translation: Oo shaqaale u xaqiiqo leh, waa inaad khatar weyn ugalaato ilaa aad shaqaale u baahan yahay inaad isku halleysid.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. Maybe it's better to keep a part-time job for stability while you build your freelance career.
dialogue.translation: Runtii bay. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad hesho shuqulka qiyaastii si aad u hesho isticmaal intaad u adeegsanaysid shuqulkaaga shaqaalaha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea. I'll think about it, although I still prefer the idea of being my own boss.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u baahan tahay inaan u fiicno. Waxaan fikiri doonaa, hadana waan jeclaanayaa inaan noqdo madaxayga.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Whatever you decide, just remember to save money for the months when you don't have a steady income.
dialogue.translation: Waxaad doonaysaa, xusuuso inaad la xiriirto lacagta bilowgii aad lixle u dhaqan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In a democratic system, the power comes from the public, but how much power does each individual actually have?
dialogue.translation: Nidaamka dimuqraadiga, xoogu wuxuu ka yimaadaa dadka, laakiin qiyaastii weeye xoogu qof kasta oo u haysto?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think the individual's role is mainly to support the system by voting, but the real decisions are made by a small group.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in shaqaalaha qofku wuxuu u dhaqanqa nidaamka oo ku noqota inuu dooro, laakiin qaar ka yar ayaa ku sameeyaa fiicinnimada xaqiiqiya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yet, a single vote can influence a decision, especially in a close election, so every vote counts.
dialogue.translation: Haddana, cod weyn oo keliya wuxuu u dhaqanqa fiicinnimo, xususan doorasho la dhaw, sidaas daraaddeed cod kasta waa la qiyaami.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That is true, but the law often protects the interests of the powerful, and therefore, the common person may feel left out.
dialogue.translation: Waa xaqiiq, laakiin xeerku badan oo kale ayuu diyaariyey maslaxadii kuwo xoog leh, sidaas daraaddeed, qofka aad u yaqaan wuxuu u maleynayaa inuu ka baxay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, is the public just a part of the machine, or can they truly shape the system?
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, ma dadku waa qaybta oo keliya ee machine, ama ma ay u dooran karaan nidaamka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I believe the system is designed to balance power, but it only works if the public actively participates.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan rumaynayaa in nidaamku wuxuu u sameeyey inuu xisaabo xoogga, laakiin wuxuu shaqeya in dadku ay qaataaan qaadan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Then the role of each individual is not just to vote, but to hold their leaders accountable.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba shaqaalaha qof kasta ma aha inuu dooro, laakiin inuu u qaato mas'uuliato u talin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly, and without that support, the common good is often ignored in favor of private interests.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa u tahay, oo aan diwaankaas lahayn, wanaagga dadku badan oo kale ayuu la qaladiyey maslahaada shakhsiya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The biggest issue with AI in hiring is that it might have a hidden bias.
dialogue.translation: Masaaladii ugu weyn ee AI oo ku salaysan wareejinta waa inay rayid weyn lahayn oo la qariso.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Do you have any evidence for that? I think AI can actually reduce human bias.
dialogue.translation: Ma haysaa dalil oo leh? Waxaan u maleynayaa in AI u taraynin rayidka dadka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: There are studies showing that AI systems often learn from past data that includes bias, so they can affect certain groups unfairly.
dialogue.translation: Waxaa jira baarro ay soo baxaan in ay niyamka AI ka badan ka tirsan macluumaadka hore ee rayidka ku jira, sidaas darteed waxay u leexihiin kooxooyin oo kala duwan oo aan adil ahayn.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see, but we should also consider the potential benefits for efficiency. However, we must be aware of the risks.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan arkay, laakiin waa inaan u fikirno faa'iidooyinka suuragalka ah ee u adag. Haddii aad u maleynaysid, waa inaan ogaanno khatarada.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True, but efficiency isn't the only factor. We also have to ensure that AI decisions are fair and transparent.
dialogue.translation: Run, laakiin suuragalkiisu ma aha midka ugu weyn. Waxaan u baahnahay inaan niyamka AI u sameeyo inay xukunka u yahay adil oo qalad.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Who is responsible if an AI makes a wrong decision? The developer, the company, or the AI itself?
dialogue.translation: Yaa u adeegsanayo haddii AI u sameeyo xukun qalad? Shaqaalaha, shirkadda, ama AI iyaga oo quduuska?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a key question. We can't assume the AI is neutral, because it's designed by people with their own values.
dialogue.translation: Waxaas su'aal muhiim ah. Ma nala kulmin in AI u yahay qalab, maxaa yeelay, waxaa loo qoray dad oo leh qimooyincyooda oo quduuska.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely. The debate goes beyond just technology; it's about our society and the future we want to build.
dialogue.translation: Run. Wadaagarka waxay u baxaan technology; waxay ku saabsan jamhuuriyadayn iyo mustaqbal aan u doonno inaan u bannaan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Now I value every moment, and I accept that some things are beyond my control.
dialogue.translation: Hadda waxaan qiimeeyaa la xilliic, waxaanna qaadanahay in waxyaabaha ay yihiin xaggiisa aan u qalin karin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That is a strong memory for you, I suppose. It gave you strength.
dialogue.translation: Waxay ku tahay xusuus badnaan, waxaan u maleynayaa. Waxay ku siisay xarumaha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That experience taught me to continue even when things get hard.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Tijaabkii aan ku baray inaan sii wadno haddii ay waxyaabaha noqoto xun.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I feel the same. It was a period of personal growth for both of us.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa sidii ay tahay. Waxay ahaatay wakhti horumar shakhsi aan labadaba u noqonay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Indeed. Looking back, I am grateful for the whole journey.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Marka aan soo jeeda, waxaan u mahadsanahay safarka oo dhan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So am I. We should talk about it more often, but perhaps not today.
dialogue.translation: Anigu qudh. Waxaan u baahanahay inaan ka hadalno badan, laakiin maanta mayno.

scenario: Discussing the role of humor in communication
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Waxaa la isticmaalaa in lagu hadlo xaalad ama xanuunka wax.
Wax ku xidhnahay inaan wax tarmi wax u dhaco ama inaad ka baxdo qof/wax.
Qalabka, waxay tusaale ahaan tahay 'parecer' (to seem) ama 'aparecer' (to show up).
Wax ku xidhnahay inaad u soo galato su'aal ama xaalad oo ah sid joogto ah.
Waxay u tahay waxa ku saabsan waxa ku dhacaya ilaa jeer ama waxa u dhexeeyaad.
Wax ku xidhnahay inaad u adeegsan tahay wax (xiriir, muuqaal, iyadoo la kulmay).
Waxay u tahay waxa ku saabsan waxa ku dhacaya ilaa jeer ama waxa u dhexeeyaad.
Waxay u cadayn tahay in waxa u dhacdo.
Waxaa la isticmaalaa in lagu qaladho hadalka (bastante) ama in lagu soo jeedo doorashada (más bien).
Waxay u cadayn tahay in waxa u dhacdo xaddo ama meeshad.
Qeybta dhexdhexaad ee hadalka, waxay tusaale ahaan tahay 'sin embargo' ama 'pero'. (Tusaale: ma isticmaali conjunción halkan).
Waxay u cadayn tahay in waxa u dhacdo shart.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think humor has a huge impact on communication, but its success depends on the degree of trust between people.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in dhumucyada waxay leeyihiin taathir weyn oo kaliya xog diyaarinta, laakiin guulistayada waxay ku talin tahay xanuunka rumaysad ee dhexdhexaad ee dadka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely. If you don't know someone well, you should avoid jokes that could be misinterpreted.
dialogue.translation: Haddii aad qof aanad u garanayn, waa inaad ka baxdo dhumucyo aan la fahmo karo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. A joke might appear funny to you, but it can seem offensive to the other person.
dialogue.translation: Soo jeeda. Dhumucyo waxay kuu muuqataa dhumucyo, laakiin qof kale waxay u muuqataa cadaabisa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, how do you approach humor at work, then? I find that a light joke can make the atmosphere more positive.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, sidee baad u soo galaysaa dhumucyada shaqo? Waxaan helay in dhumucyo yar ayaa u qalin karaa hawada inuu noqdo waana badan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to use it, but the immediate reaction is not always good. Sometimes people just stare at you.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ku dadaali inaan isticmaalayo, laakiin fiiriinta xaan ayaan aan u fiicnayn. Qaar ka mid ah dadku waxay ku fiicisan yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right. I think the key is to maintain a balance. Don't force it, and read the room first.
dialogue.translation: Soo jeeda. Waxaan u maleynayaa in midaanka waa inaad u adeegsan tahay midaanka. Ha u xad gudbina, oo akhri meesha ugu horreysa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True. If you do it too often, your colleagues will likely stop taking you seriously, though.
dialogue.translation: Runtii. Haddii aad u badan u samaysid, shaqaalahaadu ku talin doonaan inay ku noqon doonaan adigoo u maleynaya, laakiin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, humor is rather powerful. It goes beyond simple laughter. It builds bonds, but unless you are careful, it can also break them.
dialogue.translation: Haa, dhumucyadu waa u adag. Waxay u badantahay dhumucyo yar. Waxay u adeegsan yihiin xiriirka, laakiin haddii aadan u fiicnayn, waxay u baxsan yihiin.

scenario: Presenting a research finding
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Waxaa la isticmaalaa inuu soo baxaa natiijo oo muhiim ah ama aan la xiriira xad gudub.
Ingiriisiga akkaadka ah waxaa lagu isticmaalaa isku-dhexeeyey.
Fid: regular, dhamaad -yze (abuurka Amarikan).
Gargaarka, qaybo oo loo baahan yahay dadka ama suuragalka loo baahan yahay.
Waxaa la isticmaalaa 'to': similar to.
Waxaa la isticmaalaa 'to' ama 'with'.
Badanaa lagu soo baxaa isku-dhexeeyey: results.
Sayansada, waxay u ogolaanayaa in lagu soo bandhigo arrimaha ama qalabka.
Qoraalka ee umuma ah ee bedelka ama tijaabka.
Fid: adverbi, waxay beddelaa fiilka.
Dhab ahaan waxaa lagu soo daraa 'to': according to.
Waxay soo baxay qaybo ama la soo dhaafay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've finished analyzing the data from our latest survey. Do you want to see the results?
dialogue.translation: Waxaan dhamaystay inaan u fahmo da’o-gaarka ugu dambeeyey. Ma ayad doonaysaa inaad u aragto natiijada?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, please! Did you compare the responses from the two different age groups?
dialogue.translation: Haa, fadlan! Ma ayad u dooranaysaa jabiyada qaybaha saddex jirka oo kala duwan?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Of course. According to the initial figures, the younger group shows a significant increase in usage.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Bilowga ugu horeeya, qaybta ugu horreeya waxay bixisaa xiiso badan oo badan oo lagu isticmaalayo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's interesting. Did you observe any other notable patterns in that sample?
dialogue.translation: Waxaa u adag yahay. Ma ayad u aragtay qoraal kale oo leh fiican oo kale qaybtaas?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we saw a clear trend: the older group's numbers remained stable, although they started from a higher point.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxaan arkay qoraal xanuun: tirada qaybta ugu weynayd ayay ku noqdeen xanuun, iyaga oo bilaabay inay bilaabeen meel fog.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So the findings are quite similar to last year's study, but with a sharper contrast in the younger demographic.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, helitaanka waxay u eg yahay gargaarka ee bilowga horay, laakiin kala duwan oo badan oo kale oo leh qaybta ugu horreysa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. This clearly demonstrates that our new approach is working as intended.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Waxaana u muujinayaa si cad in tijaabkayn cusub waxay u shaqeynayaa sida loo doonayo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Excellent. Let's prepare the final report and present these findings to the team tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Wanaagsan. Waxaan diyaarsan doonnaa warbixinta u dambeeyey oo aan u soo baxay helitaankaas ii soo baxay dhinacyada berri.

key_phrases.translation: waxaana u muujinayaa si cad in

scenario: Discussing inequality and social mobility
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Wuxuu u dugsiyaa lacagta laga helayo shaqo ama shir-biasha.
Fariin ama masafa ay u dhiganta labada wax, halkan ay u dhiganta kuwa adag iyo kuwa baaha.
Haal fog si loo hel karo wixii la doonayo.
Xaaladda bulshada ama qoyska shakhs.
Wuxuu soo baxay toban; lagu isticmaalayo magaca ama shir-bi.
Dhammaan u dhexeeya wax ku saabsan natiijo.
Dhammaan u dhexeeya wax ku saabsan toban.
Sameeyo in wax u fiicno.
Sameeyo dhiirrigelin weyn si loo hel karo wixii la doonayo.
Baxaan ama ku guuraysaa kor.
Waxay u dugsiyaa bulshada.
Badhtamihii badda ah oo lacag ah.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been reading about the income gap in our country, and it's shocking how wide it has become.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan akhrinayaa waxa ku saabsan fariinka lacagta dalkeenna, oo waa isku dayo sidii ay u badantahay.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but the real problem is the lack of opportunity for those from a poor background to improve their situation.
dialogue.translation: Haa, laakiin dhibaatooyinka qumman waa carshigga fursadada ee kuwa ka yimid qoyska baaha inay fiicisan yareenkii.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Despite all the talk about equal rights, many people still struggle to get a decent job.
dialogue.translation: Haddii la doonayo waxa lagu hadlayaa xaquuqa si toban, dad badan oo ka badan weli ayay ku dhiirran yihiin inay heliyaan shaqo wanaagsan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Therefore, social mobility is almost impossible for them; they remain stuck in the same class.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa darteed, ku guuraysi bulshada waa u dhow aniga oo aan u dhowan karo; ayay ku dhex joogsan yihiin qaybtaas.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: However, I know a few cases where people managed to rise despite their humble beginnings.
dialogue.translation: Haddii la doonayo, waxaan ogahay qiyaastii aan u adagayn in dadku ay u guuraysaan haddii ay ku jiraan bilowgaankiisii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But those are rare exceptions; the wealth is concentrated in a few hands, and that's the core issue.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin kuwaas waxay ahayd cadaawado dhexdhexaad ah; badhtamihii wuxuu ku xigtaa gacmo badan, oo waa dhibaatooyinka ugu muhiimsan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, what can we do to change this? Maybe better education is the answer.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, maxay nuuga dhamaad inaanu beddelno? Waxaad u dhaxaysaa waxbarashada wanaagsan oo jawaabta.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Education helps, but we also need policies that directly address the gap, otherwise nothing will really change.
dialogue.translation: Waxbarashada waxay ka caawisaa, laakiin waxaannu u baahnahay siyasad oo u digto fariimaha, haddii aan, waxba aan haistiisiin doono.

scenario: Talking about leadership styles
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Waxay u adeegsan tahay in la qaadiyo shirka ama shaqo.
Tariiqo cadaalad ah oo sama leh.
U sheeg si cad cad u samaynayo.
Ku caawin ama ku taageeraya qof.
Dooro kor u eg.
Dad badan oo la shaqeeyo.
U qaad ama u dhex qaad shir.
Xuquuq ama awood si loo sameeyo go'an.
Awood u eg lubada in la iska dhigo.
Khamriyahay, ma ay ogolaan xadka.
Wajib u sameeya wax ama u dhawro wax.
Waxay bixisaa natiijo la doonayo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the best way to manage a project is to be flexible with your team.
dialogue.translation: Waan u maleynayaa in dooro wanaagsan u qaadi shaqo wuxuu ahaa inaad la iska dhahdo shirkaaga.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But if you're too flexible, people may not take their responsibility seriously.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin haddaad u badantahay inaad iska dhahdo, dadku ma ay u qaadan karo mas'uuliyaadkooda si xadgudub.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I prefer to lead by supporting others rather than giving strict orders.
dialogue.translation: Waan dooranayaa inaan u qaad qofka kale ku caawida in aan sii noqdo amarkaan xadgudub.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: In my experience, a leader must have authority and make decisions quickly.
dialogue.translation: Tajribadayda, u talinayaa in qaayeelku ha lahaado xukun oo ha sameeyo go'an si degdeg ah.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the most effective leaders direct without being authoritarian.
dialogue.translation: Haa, laakiin qaayeelka ugu xaqiiqo badan waxay u qaadayaan si aan u noqon xukun.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right. A strict style can work, but it may not be the best for every team.
dialogue.translation: Owki, waad saxan tahay. Xiiso xadgudub wuxuu u shaqeeya, laakiin ma ay noqon karo wanaagsan u tahay in la isticmaalo qof waluba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. So, how do you usually manage conflict within your team?
dialogue.translation: Sidaa u tahay. Marka, sidee baad u qaadan doonaa khilaafad shirkaaga?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to support each person and give them more responsibility when they're ready.
dialogue.translation: Waan jeclaan ku caawin qof waluba oo aan sii noqdo mas'uuliyaad badan markay u diyaarsanaadaan.
